boundary: Fresh lightweight setup and operation. Expanded-key import, caller copies, keygen encoding, output checks, negative checks, and ownership checks excluded. No persistent key/matrix cache.
confirmation_rule: A cell replicates the Java25 screen only if it qualified there and independently improves aggregate Java17 wall and calling-thread CPU by at least 3%, with all four Java17 wall rounds improving. A candidate is supported only if at least one cell replicates and no other Java17 cell has both aggregate wall regression above 3% and all four wall rounds slower. Retain every loss and allocation result. Java25 and Java17 timings are never combined; this bounded cross-runtime/held-out-key confirmation does not establish statistical significance or universal performance.
